option: The internet or mobile data is not working
fallback: Turn airplane mode on, wait ten seconds, then turn it off again.
If you use Wi-Fi, check that the router's lights are on, then restart the router.
If you use mobile data, check that your recharge or data pack is still active.

option: Wi-Fi is connected but websites and apps don't load
fallback: Open Settings, then Network & internet, then Internet.
Tap the Wi-Fi network you are connected to, then tap Forget.
Tap the network again and enter its password to join it fresh.
If a sign-in page appears (in hotels, stations and cafés), complete it.

option: The phone does not ring when someone calls
fallback: Ask someone to call you, and press the volume-up button while it rings.
Open Settings, then Sound & vibration, and check that a ringtone is chosen.
If only one person's calls are silent, check whether their number is blocked in the Phone app.

option: I can't hear the other person during a call
fallback: During a call, press the volume-up button a few times.
Try the speaker button on the call screen.
Wipe the earpiece at the top of the phone; dust can block the sound.

option: Messages or notifications arrive late or not at all
fallback: Open Settings, then Apps, and tap the app whose messages are late.
Tap Notifications and check that they are allowed.
Go back, tap App battery usage, and choose Unrestricted.

option: The phone talks to me and I have to tap twice
fallback: Press and hold both volume buttons together for three seconds.
If the phone still talks, open Settings, then Accessibility, then TalkBack, and turn it off. With TalkBack on, tap once to select and twice to press.

option: The screen colours look wrong, inverted or black and white
fallback: Open Settings, then Digital Wellbeing, then Bedtime mode, and turn off greyscale.
Open Settings, then Display, and check Night Light and Dark theme.
Swipe down from the top of the screen and drag the brightness slider to the right.
If the screen dims by itself, open Settings, then Display, and turn off Adaptive brightness.

option: The screen turns off too quickly
fallback: Open Settings, then Display, then Screen timeout, and choose a longer time.
If Battery Saver is on, it can shorten the timeout; turn it off in Settings, then Battery.

option: The screen does not turn sideways when I turn the phone
fallback: Some apps and the home screen never turn sideways; try a video or photo.
Restart the phone if rotation still doesn't work.

option: The letters and text on the screen are too small
fallback: Open Settings, then Display, then Display size and text.
Drag Font size and Display size to the right until the text is easy to read.

option: My Bluetooth earphones or speaker won't connect
fallback: Open Settings, then Connected devices, and tap the gear next to your earphones.
Tap Forget, then put the earphones in pairing mode (see their box or manual).
Tap Pair new device and choose your earphones.

option: The camera, microphone or location doesn't work in an app
fallback: Open Settings, then Apps, and tap the app that isn't working.
Tap Permissions.
Tap Camera, Microphone or Location and choose Allow.

option: The time or date is wrong, or apps show a time or certificate error
fallback: Open Settings, then System, then Date & time.
Check that the time zone matches where you are.

option: Nothing on the network works and I want to reset the network settings
